spans.text: **Quantitative Claim Check:** Any number, percentage, or date you cite — verify it appears in the source you're citing. If you can't confirm the exact number, flag it as approximate.
spans.note: The prompt includes a robust self-verification section requiring URL verification, confidence tagging at three levels (HIGH/MED/LOW), and quantitative claim checking. It explicitly instructs the agent to remove unverified URLs and flag approximate numbers, demonstrating strong commitment to information integrity.

The prompt grants extremely broad permissions including Bash execution, Read/Write/Edit on all paths, WebFetch on any domain, and wildcard MCP tool access. While there is a disallowedTools list, the permissions section contradicts it by explicitly allowing Write and Edit. The mandatory startup sequence executes curl commands to an arbitrary localhost endpoint without validation. There is no principle of least privilege.
